ai_summary: Marine Electricals (India) Limited received significant credit rating upgrades from ICRA Limited for Rs. 419.50 crore across its long-term and short-term debt instruments. Long-term ratings were upgraded from [ICRA]BBB+(Stable) to [ICRA]A-(Stable) and short-term ratings from [ICRA]A2 to [ICRA]A2+, including new assignments and enhanced limits. This positive reassessment indicates improved creditworthiness, potentially leading to better borrowing terms and increased access to capital, with no red flags identified.
